questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.A) Women’s education is the key to empowering women and achieving gender equality.B) Education helps break the cycle of poverty, as educated women are more likely to contribute to the economic and social development of their families and communities.C) It provides women with the knowledge, skills, and confidence to make informed decisions about their lives, whether in their careers, health, or personal development.D) Ultimately, women’s education is essential not only for advancing women’s rights but also for fostering a more just, equitable, and prosperous society for all.E) It also promotes women's participation in politics and leadership, challenging traditional gender roles and creating opportunities for greater societal representation.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.The modern and alternative medicines are now winning greater acceptance _______ doctors.

Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the segment given in the brackets to rectify the sentence.Implementing the new policy caused some initial disruption, but you can't (make a cake without breaking eggs.)
options: get blood out of a turnip.
have your cake and eat it too.
make an omelette without breaking eggs.
make a silk purse from a sow's ear.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (make an omelette without breaking eggs.) है।

Comprehension:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.The old lighthouse stood on the cliffs, weathered by years of crashing waves and fierce storms. It had been guiding ships safely into the harbour for centuries. But one evening, as the sun dipped below the horizon, the lighthouse keeper noticed something strange. The light, which had always burned bright and steady, flickered faintly before going out completely. Alarmed, he hurried up the spiral staircase to investigate. The source of the problem was clear: the bulb had burned out.As the keeper tried to replace the bulb, a thick fog rolled in, obscuring the view of the sea. The boats that depended on the lighthouse’s beacon were now vulnerable. Without hesitation, the keeper grabbed a flashlight, climbed back down the tower, and walked along the rocky path that led to the harbour. He used the beam of light to guide the incoming ships, ensuring they navigated safely.By the time he returned to the lighthouse, the fog had cleared, and the light was shining again. The keeper breathed a sigh of relief, knowing that his quick thinking had prevented a disaster. This experience reminded him of the vital role he played in ensuring the safety of others, a responsibility he took very seriously.What is the most suitable title for the passage?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (The Lighthouse Keeper's Duty) है।
